title: Record state-broadcast mailbox overflow loss with a counter and bounded diagnostic
outcome: Producer mailbox loss is observable without adding overload-proportional logging or weakening lagged recovery.
acceptance: A deterministic mailbox overflow test verifies loss count and diagnostic admission without changing the non-evictable lagged marker or queue ordering.
Mailbox overflow increments an attributable loss counter and emits a bounded diagnostic consistent with the host architecture contract; ordinary queue operation does neither.
